title: did-hosting/1.0/status-request
description: Anyone to host: asks about a name, or about the name the sender holds.

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender.

from.description: Sender DID. Every message of this protocol is authcrypted, so it is always present.

thid.description: Thread id; the id of the message that started the thread.

return_route.description: return_route extension; set to all to receive the reply on the same connection.

name.description: A name: labels of 3 to 32 characters (a-z, 0-9, -; no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen) joined by ':'.
